_meta: Per-key notes for CONTROL.txt. The key LIST lives only in CONTROL_FIELD_SPECS (delfin/common/control_validator.py:2087-2283); this file adds knowledge, never a second list. Every read_by was traced in the DELFIN source this session, file:line, not guessed. best_practice carries a source or is omitted.

charge.meaning: Total charge of the system, integer; shifts the electron count DELFIN computes from the input geometry (delfin/cli.py:1997 calculate_total_electrons_txt) and appears in every ORCA input header.
charge.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:1100 (_as_charge); consumed via the validated config into ORCA inputs.
charge.best_practice: Match the physical species: cationic metal complexes change electron count and therefore spin state. Verify against the input file's actual electrons.

method.meaning: Which DELFIN workflow engine runs: classic (the standard pipeline), manually (user-driven steps), OCCUPIER (spin-state/oxidation enumeration with FoB jobs and even_seq/odd_seq sequences).
method.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2188 (_as_method; values at :2360-2366 the OCCUPIER check).
method.best_practice: OCCUPIER only when the question is spin/oxidation-state enumeration; classic otherwise.

functional.meaning: The DFT functional written into every ORCA keyword line. Names resolve case-insensitively against ORCA_FUNCTIONALS; LibXC(...) names pass through, and unknown names are passed through unchanged so ORCA itself fails fast on a typo (control_validator.py:1170-1178).
functional.valid_values: ORCA functional name, e.g. PBE0, B3LYP, wB97X-D4, or LibXC(<name>)
functional.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2203 (_as_functional :1159-1178); reaches the ORCA keyword line via the input generators.
functional.best_practice: For excited states and transition metals prefer a functional with a dispersion suffix or pair it with disp_corr; pair double-hybrids with exact limits. Source: ORCA 6 manual, DFT chapters (see search_docs).

main_basisset.meaning: Basis set for non-metal atoms on the non-relativistic branch.
main_basisset.valid_values: ORCA basis name, e.g. def2-SVP, def2-TZVP
main_basisset.best_practice: def2-SVP for screening, def2-TZVP (or TPSSh/def2-TZVP for 3d) for production energetics; source: ORCA 6 manual basis-set chapters.

main_basisset_rel.meaning: Basis set on the relativistic branch (4d/5d/4f/5f systems), when set_main_basisset picks the _rel keys.
main_basisset_rel.valid_values: relativistic basis name, e.g. ZORA-def2-SVP, SARC-ZORA
main_basisset_rel.best_practice: Leave empty to get ZORA-def2-SVP automatically; set explicitly only for SARC/ZORA basis pairs per element. Source: ORCA 6 manual, relativistic corrections chapter (ZORA section).

metal_basisset.meaning: Per-atom basis override for the metal atoms, non-relativistic branch (3d metals).
metal_basisset.best_practice: 3d metals: often left empty (main basis covers them); set e.g. def2-TZVP on the metal only for production energetics.

metal_basisset_rel.meaning: Per-atom metal basis override on the relativistic branch.
metal_basisset_rel.best_practice: ZORA-def2-TZVP on the metal for production. Source: ORCA 6 manual relativistic chapters.

aux_jk.meaning: Auxiliary JK fitting basis on the non-relativistic branch.
aux_jk.valid_values: e.g. def2/J, def2-TZVPP/CPCM; empty means DELFIN's default
aux_jk.best_practice: Leave the default; only change with a documented reason.

aux_jk_rel.meaning: Auxiliary JK fitting basis on the relativistic branch.
aux_jk_rel.valid_values: e.g. SARC/J; empty means DELFIN's default
aux_jk_rel.best_practice: SARC/J for ZORA/SARC bases. Source: ORCA 6 manual, auxiliary basis sets.

relativity.meaning: Relativistic Hamiltonian token. DECIDED AUTOMATICALLY: for light-element systems delfin/cli.py:1989-1994 forces relativity=none (with an info log); for 4d/5d/4f/5f systems utils._should_use_rel (delfin/utils.py:203-217) selects the relativistic branch and _rel basis keys. A validator finding must flag only a setting the auto policy would not produce, never block on 'missing'.
relativity.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2212 (:1324-1337 _as_relativity); auto policy delfin/utils.py:203-217 and delfin/cli.py:1989-1994.
relativity.best_practice: Leave at none: the policy applies it per system class automatically (ZORA default on the relativistic branch via the _rel keys).

initial_guess.meaning: Initial guess for the SCF of every ORCA job.
initial_guess.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2211 (:1413-1429); delfin/esd_input_generator.py:766,813-815 (PModel dropped when a MOREAD file is present); delfin/occupier.py:404,427; delfin/xyz_io.py:515.
initial_guess.best_practice: PModel default; HCore/Hueckel for hard SCF convergence on anions/open-shell. Source: ORCA 6 manual, SCF convergence chapter.

geom_opt.meaning: Geometry-optimisation keyword block for standard jobs.
geom_opt.valid_values: must start with OPT | OPTTS | TIGHTOPT | VERYTIGHTOPT, additional ORCA keywords allowed
geom_opt.best_practice: TIGHTOPT for energetics that compare minima (isomer rankings); source: ORCA 6 manual, geometry optimization.

freq_type.meaning: Analytical (FREQ) or numerical (NUMFREQ) frequencies wherever a frequency run is requested. Consumers fall back to FREQ on any other spelling, so a typo would silently switch cost, not fail: delfin/esd_input_generator.py:761-763,1260-1262 and delfin/xyz_io.py:535-538.
freq_type.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2215 (:1400-1410); consumers delfin/esd_input_generator.py:761-763, delfin/xyz_io.py:535-538, delfin/esd_module.py via input generator.
freq_type.best_practice: NUMFREQ only when the method has no analytical Hessian (e.g. some double-hybrids); far more expensive. Source: ORCA 6 manual, frequencies.

solvent.meaning: Name of the implicit solvent (matched case-insensitively against ORCA's solvent list). Together with implicit_solvation_model it becomes e.g. CPCM(DMF). Consumers build the keyword via delfin/common/solvation.py:18-46: model without solvent is warned and dropped (gas phase); SOLVENT WITHOUT MODEL returns an empty keyword SILENTLY at solvation.py:31-32 -- the P3 cross-check target.
solvent.valid_values: ORCA solvent name, e.g. DMF, water, toluene (see ORCA_SOLVENTS, control_validator.py:25-281)
solvent.best_practice: Set solvent AND implicit_solvation_model together (e.g. CPCM + solvent). CPCM for routine, SMD when solvation free energies matter; source: ORCA 6 manual, implicit solvation models chapter.

implicit_solvation_model.meaning: Implicit solvation model: CPCM or SMD. Bare C-PCM spelling is normalised. With solvent it forms the ORCA solvation keyword; without solvent it is dropped with a warning and the run goes gas phase (delfin/common/solvation.py:34-44).
implicit_solvation_model.best_practice: Set together with solvent. CPCM for routine screening; SMD for solvation free energies. Source: ORCA 6 manual, solvation models.

PAL.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2092; read into ORCA %pal blocks by the input generators.
PAL.best_practice: Match the queue allocation; PAL mismatched to the allocation wastes or over-commits cores.

ri_jkx.meaning: RI-type keyword for J/K/X handling on the keyword line.
ri_jkx.valid_values: RI | NORI | SPLITRIJ | NOSPLITRIJ | NOSPLITRIJK | RIJONX | RIJDX | RIJCOSX | NORIJCOSX | NOCOSX | RIJK | NOSFITTING
ri_jkx.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2204 (:1448-1498); reaches keyword lines via input generators.
ri_jkx.best_practice: RIJCOSX is ORCA's recommended default for GGA/hybrid DFT; RIJK for pure functionals. Source: ORCA 6 manual, RI chapter.

xTB_method.meaning: Semi-empirical method for xTB-based steps (pre-optimisation, screening).
xTB_method.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2192 (:1109-1113); consumed by the xTB runtime steps.
xTB_method.best_practice: XTB2 (GFN2-xTB) default for organic and most metal complexes; source: Bannwarth et al., J. Chem. Theory Comput. 2019, 15, 1652, DOI 10.1021/acs.jctc.8b01176.

XTB_OPT.meaning: Pre-optimise geometries with xTB before the DFT level.
XTB_OPT.valid_values: yes | no (True/1 accepted and normalised, control_validator.py:2193-2196)
XTB_OPT.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2198; consumed by the runtime pre-optimisation step.
XTB_OPT.best_practice: yes for large systems to cut DFT core-hours; the DFT geometry starts from the xTB minimum.

XTB_GOAT.meaning: Conformer/isomer search with xTB GOAT before the DFT level.
XTB_GOAT.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py; consumed by the runtime conformer-search step.
XTB_GOAT.best_practice: For flexible ligands set yes; costs xTB core-hours that buy a better starting ensemble.

CREST.meaning: Use the standalone CREST program for the conformer search instead of GOAT.
CREST.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py; consumed by the runtime conformer-search step.
CREST.best_practice: Either CREST or XTB_GOAT, not both; CREST for large flexible systems. Source: Pracht et al., J. Comput. Chem. 2020, 41, 1931, DOI 10.1002/jcc.26137.

OCCUPIER_method.meaning: How OCCUPIER enumerates electron configurations: auto (DELFIN decides) or manually (user supplies even_seq/odd_seq sequence blocks).
OCCUPIER_method.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2228; occupier enumeration logic in delfin/occupier.py.
OCCUPIER_method.best_practice: auto unless you have a specific configuration in mind; manually requires well-formed even_seq/odd_seq blocks (validator :2414-2497).

OCCUPIER_compare.meaning: Which energy OCCUPIER ranks candidate configurations by: FSPE (electronic, FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY) or G (Gibbs free energy, adds a frequency run per candidate).
OCCUPIER_compare.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2191,2587-2599 (legacy derivation from frequency_calculation_OCCUPIER); consumed by delfin/occupier.py ranking.
OCCUPIER_compare.best_practice: FSPE for spin-state ordering; G only when the ranking question is thermodynamic (costs one freq job per candidate).

IMAG_scope.meaning: Which structures IMAG takes off imaginary modes: all (initial + every redox step) or initial (initial structure only). ESD excited states are always treated.
IMAG_scope.best_practice: all for redox workflows; initial to cut cost when only the initial structure feeds downstream rates.

IMAG_option.meaning: IMAG variant selector (1/2/3 or none) -- which displacement protocol removes the mode.

IMAG_max_rounds.meaning: Maximum IMAG rounds per structure: SPs both sides of the mode + re-optimisation from the lower side.
IMAG_max_rounds.best_practice: 2 default; raise only for stubborn soft modes, each round costs SPs + a Hessian.

allow_imaginary_freq.meaning: Noise floor in cm-1: imaginary modes smaller in magnitude are noise (kept), larger make a saddle (IMAG acts). Written negative, e.g. -50. Old value 0 reads as -50.
allow_imaginary_freq.valid_values: negative float, e.g. -50; -0.1 treats every imaginary mode
allow_imaginary_freq.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2224-2225 (:1238-1260); consumed by the IMAG workflow and ESD rate gating.
allow_imaginary_freq.best_practice: -50 default; lower it toward -0.1 only when a true soft mode matters scientifically.

frequency_calculation.meaning: Request a frequency run in the classic workflow (thermochemistry, minima check).
frequency_calculation.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2189; consumed by the classic pipeline step generation.
frequency_calculation.best_practice: yes whenever Gibbs energies are quoted; a minimum without frequencies is unverified.

states.meaning: Which excited states the ESD module computes rates for (e.g. S1>T1,T1>S1 style transitions / state list). Only active with ESD_modul=yes; gated at control_validator.py:2386-2388.
states.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2258; consumed by the ESD module (delfin/esd_module.py).
states.best_practice: List exactly the transitions the scientific question asks; each costs rate jobs.

ESD_modus.meaning: ESD rate method: tddft (linear-response TD-DFT rates).
ESD_modus.best_practice: Leave default; validated keys with their own coercion at :2374-2377.

TDDFT_nroots.meaning: Number of excited states ORCA computes per TD-DFT job (NRoots). Must reach the highest root any job asks for: S3 needs >= 3.
TDDFT_nroots.read_by: delfin/common/control_validator.py:2239; consumed via delfin/common/tddft_settings.py into every %tddft block.
TDDFT_nroots.best_practice: Set to a few above the highest state of interest; too few silently truncates the state you asked for.

TDDFT_TDA.meaning: Tamm-Dancoff approximation in every TD-DFT job (ORCA default true). false = full TD-DFT (RPA).
TDDFT_TDA.best_practice: true default (stable on triplet-unstable references); false when excitation energies need RPA quality. Source: ORCA 6 manual, TD-DFT chapter.
